Tom and Jerry🎬is a famous animated cartoon series created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera. The story mainly follows Tom, a clever but sometimes foolish cat, and Jerry, a small, intelligent mouse who lives in the same house. Tom is always trying to catch Jerry, but Jerry usually escapes using his quick thinking and clever tricks.

Their endless chase leads to funny situations, exciting adventures, and lots of harmless chaos. Sometimes Tom creates complicated plans to catch Jerry, but they often backfire and cause trouble for him. Jerry may be smaller, but he is usually one step ahead of Tom. Despite being rivals, Tom and Jerry occasionally work together when they face a bigger problem or danger.

The cartoon is loved by people of all ages because it uses expressive characters, physical comedy, funny sound effects, and very little dialogue. Each episode brings a new adventure filled with laughter, surprises, and mischief. Even after countless battles, Tom and Jerry always return for another hilarious chase.

Artisti nimi: NOIRAVE (Leon Matsuda)

NOIRAVE paistab melodic trap’i skeenel jätkuvalt silma lähenemisega, mis ühendab filmilikud süntesaatorid, introspektiivsed meloodiad ja hoolikalt viimistletud elektroonilise produktsiooni. Tema lood loovad futuristliku atmosfääri, milles on mõjutusi cyberpunk’ist ja digitaalkultuurist, säilitades samal ajal ühtse helilise identiteedi, mis on pälvinud üha laiema alternatiivmuusika publiku tähelepanu.
✦ Lood nagu «Static Dreams» ja «Digital Rain» koos koostöödega sõltumatute elektroonilise muusika produtsentidega on tugevdanud tema kohalolu voogedastusplatvormidel. Tema heli pidev areng, minimalistlik visuaalne suund ja soov katsetada uute tekstuuridega muudavad NOIRAVE’i üheks uue melodic trap’i laine huvitavamaks projektiks.
